name: To The Pointe Summer Dance
description_short: A dance studio's summer program with weekly themed day camps at its Cranston, RI location, grouped by age and taught by studio dance teachers. No experience is needed. The studio also runs 6-week weekly classes at its three RI locations and a 6-week intensive for experienced dancers.
